classification.difficultyReason: Identify nested similar right triangles from a verbal description and use corresponding heights and horizontal distances.

content.prompt: A line from the top of a church steeple to the ground just passes over the top of a pole $2.5$ m high and meets the ground at a point $A$, $1.5$ m from the base of the pole. If the distance from $A$ to a point directly below the church steeple is $30$ m, find the height of the steeple.

answer.worked:
Let the height of the steeple be $h$ metres. The steeple and pole form two right-angled triangles with the ground. Their angles at $A$ are equal because their tops lie on the same line through $A$, so the triangles are similar by AAA.

Matching heights and horizontal distances give
$$\begin{align*}\frac{h}{2.5}&=\frac{30}{1.5}\\h&=2.5\times20\\h&=50.\end{align*}$$
The height of the steeple is $50\text{ m}$.
